note: Coach-name spellings, canonical -> [variants]. The canonical name is the researched tenure files' spelling; a variant is another source's spelling of the same person (CFBD /coaches via data/coach-stints.json). build-records.mjs and build-coach-stints.mjs map every variant onto the canonical name, so one person keeps one record. Add a row when build-coach-stints.mjs prints a seam mismatch or coverage-report.mjs prints a name-variant suspect that is the same person.
